articles.title: Open USD rattled Circle's stock, but its key backers still support USDC
articles.snippet: Executives at Coinbase, Visa and Mastercard said they plan to support multiple stablecoins, suggesting Open USD is another payments rail rather than a direct replacement for USDC.

articles.title: Intesa Sanpaolo slashed IBIT stake by 94% in 2Q, tripled ether ETF holding as crypto prices slumped
articles.snippet: The Italian bank tripled its holding of iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF stake as total bitcoin ETF holdings fell 35% to $69.3 million.

articles.title: Dinari brings tokenized U.S. stocks to American investors as equity race heats up
articles.snippet: The move brings the custodial tokenization model to eligible U.S. investors as competition over blockchain-based equities intensifies.

articles.title: BitGo’s WBTC move pushes LayerZero-to-Chainlink tally near $15 billion
articles.snippet: A migration wave followed a $292 million Kelp bridge exploit, with announced LayerZero-to-Chainlink moves now totaling $14.5 billion.

articles.title: BNY to add crypto staking to digital asset custody platform
articles.snippet: The custody bank has selected Galaxy to provide staking infrastructure as it broadens services for institutional crypto investors.
